# Erfan Ahmed Siam

> Applied AI engineer at the University of Warwick, building agentic LLM
> systems, retrieval pipelines and production infrastructure. Former full-stack
> / infrastructure engineer for 100+ UK businesses.

Erfan Ahmed Siam is a software engineer working at the intersection of applied
AI and production infrastructure. He researches LLM architectures and
evaluation methods, designs agentic systems that use tool calling and retrieval,
and automates internal workflows — with 5+ years shipping Laravel, Go and cloud
systems before that.
